In this video we cover:
Green Hydrogen Push Faces Hurdles: India’s Tender Trouble
India aims to produce 5 million tonnes of green hydrogen by 2030, but delays in key government tenders are holding back progress. In this video, we break down why SECI’s green ammonia tender has been extended 11 times, what challenges the green hydrogen sector faces, and how it affects India's clean energy goals and export ambitions.
